title: Cooks, Institution and Cafeteria
description: Prepare and cook large quantities of food for institutions, such as schools, hospitals, or cafeterias.

tasks.text: Wash pots, pans, dishes, utensils, or other cooking equipment.
Apportion and serve food to facility residents, employees, or patrons.
Monitor and record food temperatures to ensure food safety.
Monitor use of government food commodities to ensure that proper procedures are followed.
Monitor menus and spending to ensure that meals are prepared economically.
Cook foodstuffs according to menus, special dietary or nutritional restrictions, or numbers of portions to be served.
Clean, cut, and cook meat, fish, or poultry.
Bake breads, rolls, or other pastries.
Take inventory of supplies and equipment.
Requisition food supplies, kitchen equipment, and appliances, based on estimates of future needs.
Clean and inspect galley equipment, kitchen appliances, and work areas to ensure cleanliness and functional operation.
Direct activities of one or more workers who assist in preparing and serving meals.
Plan menus that are varied, nutritionally balanced, and appetizing, taking advantage of foods in season and local availability.
Compile and maintain records of food use and expenditures.
Determine meal prices, based on calculations of ingredient prices.

skills.name: Spreadsheet software
skills.def: Software to create or edit numbers or text organized into rows and columns of cells. May include formulas which recalculate values based on other cells. Examples: IBM Lotus 1-2-3, Microsoft Excel.

skills.name: Word processing software
skills.def: Software to create, edit, store, or print documents. Examples: Microsoft Word.

skills.name: Analytical or scientific software
skills.def: Software to capture data, perform analysis, or generate reports or visualizations to support scientific research. Examples: GNOME Gnutrition.

skills.name: Data base user interface and query software
skills.def: Software to query, present, or edit information stored in a database sytem. Examples: Meals Plus.

skills.name: Point of sale POS software
skills.def: Software to enable billing and purchase of goods or services at retail markets or shops. May provide sales reports. Examples: PCS Revenue Control Systems FASTRAK School Meal Software.
